description: This file defines numeric types, conversions, and bit array classes within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including number serialization, deserialization, and network byte order handling.

classes.name: NumberType
classes.description: Template class for handling numeric types with conversion, serialization, and comparison functionalities.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Class representing fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts, supporting comparison and text representation.

classes.name: BitArrayBaseType
classes.description: Base template class for fixed-size bit array operations.

classes.name: BitArrayType
classes.description: Derived class for fixed-size bit array with size equal to MAXBITS.

classes.name: BitArrayFlexType
classes.description: Derived class for flexible-size bit array with adjustable size.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Static template methods for converting string representations to numeric types, supporting different bases and signedness.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns string representation of the number.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the number into a string or wide string buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string or wide string buffer into the number.

methods.name: MaxSize
methods.description: Returns maximum size needed for string representation.
